apple_promotional_text: Text a friend. Pick up a Spanish word in an English message, or switch to Deep to read the whole conversation in Spanish. Tap a message to hear it.
google_short_description: Chat with friends in two languages, one word or a whole message at a time.
description_without_subscription_terms:
Learn a language in the conversations you already want to have. Write to a friend in your own language and choose how you read the chat on your phone.

In Shallow, a message can introduce one new word. Words you’ve seen before can show up again. In Deep, read the whole message in your practice language. You can switch between the two as you chat.

Tap a message to hear the practice word or sentence. Press and hold the chat to see the original. For supported scripts, double-tap to switch between a reading in Latin letters and the native script.

Connect by username or invitation. Vipi uses the Signal Protocol to encrypt your messages end to end. Translation and speech run on your device. Some languages and voices need a download, and translations can make mistakes.

Chatting with friends is free. You can save an encrypted history backup and choose where to keep it.
